title: PolySwarm-Style Multi-LLM Kalshi Nowcasting (updated design)
summary: 50-persona LLM swarm with confidence-weighted Bayesian aggregation for binary prediction markets. PolySwarm paper demonstrates latency arbitrage on Polymarket/Kalshi specifically. TradingAgents provides open-source multi-agent infrastructure (LangGraph, supports Claude 4).

design.agents: 10-20 LLM personas (reduced from 50 for cost): fundamental analyst, momentum analyst, earnings historian, sector specialist, macro analyst, options flow analyst, etc.
design.aggregation: Confidence-weighted Bayesian voting; use KL divergence to detect cross-market inefficiencies
design.inputs: FinBERT press release score (H163), earnings call FinBERT (H168), consensus EPS, sector momentum, options Put/Call
design.entry: Take position when ensemble confidence > 0.65 and Kalshi market price > 0.15 edge
design.sizing: Quarter-Kelly based on PolySwarm paper; max 2% portfolio per contract
design.infrastructure: TradingAgents v0.2.0 as base; replace stock-trading focus with prediction market focus

success_criterion: ROI > 15% annualized on paper Kalshi account over 3-month OOS window
effort: HIGH — 1-2 weeks to implement agent swarm + Kalshi integration + paper trading
